sources.title: Uribe and Schmitt-Grohé, Open Economy Macroeconomics, chapter 8 slides: Real Exchange Rates

sources.verification: Actually opened official chapter index and 106-page PDF text, cover and section 12.3, physical pages 23–26 (PDF indices 22–25), lines 415–533: dated household budget, flow-collateral constraint and endogenous price consistency.
